comments.value:
Can you provide a link or two to example streamers that broadcast that low?

It’ll be hard to hunt one down to test.

Thanks!

@{58c6cbcffd04b1785f747b6c|full_name}: upon further testing, im not sure if its actually 1080p/720p thats causing the problem. the ones that worked for me was twitch.tv/leymley whilst twitch.tv/tyriss didnt provide any audio
Solved it. Some people stream in mono instead of stereo or 5.1 and the sound doesnt play in vrchat. (Temp fix:  by switching headset to mono audio)

Yes, I try to use sync video stream like　 Starter Guide　( https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrc_syncvideostream ) , but  audio does not play. Probably,audio does not play in vrchat  in case broadcast is not monaural.

@{5b0d57ecd5be9f110e4ba5d6|full_name}: Have you tried different VRC_VideoSpeaker configurations? -- If a single StereoMix doesn't work, set up two speakers as Left and Right and see if the audio is coming out of one of them.
@{58c6da4c23f8d63e1401d385|full_name}: 　I and my friend tried to do this, but audio does not play (About youtube live, audio play well. About twitch(not monaural broadcast),audio does not  play.)
Have you tried it on desktop? Some of my friends said this bug occurred only on VR.
If you set your audio output device to 48khz and 16bit audio, will it play?
Closing due to age, please make a new post if it is still relevant.

details:
The audio for the live stream sync (twitch) does not play for videos under 1080p/720p
EDIT: has nothing to do with 1080p/720p problem with mono/stereo sounds not playing in vrchat
title: Audio doesnt play for some twitch streams
